items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: The interviewee discusses John Forkartin's career and other musicians he played with, but does not mention any direct personal interaction or professional collaboration with Forkartin himself.

ctx.x: He went with different fellas and played music. He played with Sam Morgan, some. He played a few jobs with us, you know. And he played with Chris Kellys. Oh, yeah, that's about. Then he formed up his own band. Yeah. Formed off the board. George Lewis band. He got, first he had, oh no, he played with Kid Howard. Yes. Remember Kid Howard? Yes. Yeah, well, he played with him. But when he got out from Kid Howard, that way he formed his own band. He got this fella, Slowdrag, you know what you talking about? He played…

And that's John Forkartin. Who was drumming with him? Well, he had, of course in the late years he had Joe Watkins. Who? Joe Watkins. Joe Watkins. Well, he was a much more recent drummer. You probably don't even remember him. Yeah, no. He died fairly recently.

Yeah, yeah. Well, there's another fella. I can't think of his name. He had a drummer. He tried to get me with him and I said, no, I wouldn't. I was going to leave my brother, you know. We had such, you know, good, wonderful band. I guess you must have heard.
